snippet.title: DungeonOS — Steam Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4221660/DungeonOS/

Crawl Dungeons, Loot and Equip your Adventurers! Log in to an old-school operating system. Manage your adventurers and use puzzles to damage your enemies. Are you ready to find the five artifacts you always dreamed of?

— Are you ready for the tunes?

The soundtrack of DungeonOS was created using the original sound chip of the Sega Genesis using the Mega MIDI Synthesizer by Aidan Lawrence and other synths that contain old console chips. We don't use digital VSTs, only hardware synths for the true analog feel!
